clips.title: Yoga Class and a Smart Fridge That Reports Me
clips.hook_text: Listen to your body, they said
clips.description: A first yoga class and a smart fridge that tracks every snack. This cut starts after the greeting and stops on the cheese line, before the laugh.
clips.reason: Same two bits as the longer cut, but it starts mid-introduction and ends on the punchline before the audience laughs.

clips.title: My Body Had One Question in Yoga Class
clips.hook_text: My body had one question for my yoga teacher
clips.description: He finally tries yoga and actually listens to his body, then buys a smart fridge that sends his phone a report every night.
clips.reason: Two connected bits, each with a clear setup and a punchline that gets a big laugh; it ends right after the second laugh.

clips.title: My Smart Fridge and My Car Both Judge Me
clips.hook_text: My fridge wants to talk about the cheese
clips.description: A smart fridge reports his snacking every night, and his car's voice assistant has opinions about the drive home.
clips.reason: Two gadget bits with the same structure and two strong laughs; the second punchline tops the first.

clips.title: Car Assistant Recalculates His Life Choices
clips.hook_text: I asked my car to take me home
clips.description: His car's voice assistant thinks for a long time before giving a brutally honest answer about the way home. Ends with the sign-off.
clips.reason: A single bit with a clean setup, a long pause and a big laugh, followed by a warm sign-off.

clips.title: Why Are We on the Floor?
clips.description: The yoga teacher says to listen to your body, so he does, and his body has one simple question.
clips.reason: The tightest version of the yoga joke: one setup, one punchline and the full laugh.
